one_liner_zh: 科磊EPS小幅超預期2.5%，營收年增11.5%顯示半導體製程檢測需求穩健。
one_liner_en: KLA modestly beat EPS by 2.5% with 11.5% revenue growth, reflecting steady semiconductor process-control demand.
beat_or_miss: 超預期 / EPS超預期2.50%，營收年增11.49%反映檢測設備需求穩。
ai_view_zh: 訊號穩健偏正：EPS溫和超預期搭配11.5%營收年增，顯示先進製程與AI晶片帶動檢測設備需求，龍頭地位穩固。短期股價有支撑，惟71倍本益比已反映高預期。中期關注先進製程資本支出循環與中國市場出口管制影響。追蹤指標：訂單與出貨能見度、服務營收占比、毛利率、各製程節點與終端需求，以及中國營收占比變化。
ai_view_en: Signal is steady-to-positive: a modest EPS beat with 11.5% revenue growth shows advanced-node and AI-chip demand lifting process-control orders, with solid leadership. Near-term the stock has support, though a 71x P/E embeds high expectations. Mid-term watch the advanced-node capex cycle and China export-control impact. Track: order and shipment visibility, service-revenue mix, gross margin, node/end-market demand, and changes in China revenue exposure.
highlights_zh: EPS 0.94美元，超出預期0.92美元，超預期幅度2.50%
營收34.2億美元，年增11.49%，受惠先進製程與AI晶片資本支出
製程檢測（process control）龍頭地位提供高進入障礙
高毛利與穩定服務營收支撑獲利品質
highlights_en: EPS of $0.94 beat the $0.92 estimate by 2.50%
Revenue of $3.42B grew 11.49%, aided by advanced-node and AI-chip capex
Leadership in process control provides high barriers to entry
High gross margins and stable service revenue support earnings quality
risks_zh: 本益比71倍偏高，估值已反映AI資本支出樂觀
半導體資本支出具週期性，記憶體與成熟製程需求波動
地緣政治與出口管制可能影響中國市場營收
risks_en: A 71x P/E is elevated, already pricing in AI-capex optimism
Semiconductor capex is cyclical, with memory and mature-node demand volatile
Geopolitics and export controls could affect China revenue
